scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Build a multiplicity ledger before joining facts
cases.input_contract: Return key, fact_rows, dimension_rows, predicted_inner for the union of key buckets. Merge NULL diagnostic buckets explicitly, but predict zero ordinary-equality pairs for NULL. Order keys with NULL last.
cases.verification: Assert the full ledger and its summed predicted count, including unmatched right-only E and the NULL bucket.

cases.title: Verify equality pairs and quantify fanout
cases.input_contract: Return fact_id, dimension_row, amount_cents from an ordinary inner equality join. Compare both DataFrame and SQL pair identities with the seven literal expected pairs.
cases.expected: Facts 1 and 2 each match dimension rows 101,102,103;fact 3 matches 104. There are 7 pairs and the repeated joined amount totals 120, while matched fact amounts total 60.
cases.verification: Assert every pair, count 7 and pair-grain sum 120;compare a SQL join to the same pair list.

cases.title: Count actual matches in a left join
cases.input_contract: Return fact_id, dimension_row from an ordinary left equality join. Preserve unmatched facts with a NULL right identity and inspect rows ordered by fact_id, dimension_row.
cases.expected: There are 10 output rows but 7 nonnull dimension_row values. Facts 4,5,6 each have one NULL-extended row;all six fact IDs remain represented.
cases.verification: Assert the complete ordered pair/NULL list and distinguish COUNT(*)10 from COUNT(dimension_row)7.

cases.title: Use semi and anti joins for membership
cases.input_contract: Return a pair of DataFrames containing matched and unmatched facts under ordinary equality, using left_semi and left_anti. Preserve fact rows without right-side fanout.
cases.expected: Semi IDs are[1,2,3], anti IDs[4,5,6]. Key A contributes two semi rows despite three dimension matches. Their bags reconcile to all six facts.
cases.verification: Assert both exact ID lists and their combined count 6;do not use distinct to repair an inner join.

cases.title: Make NULL-safe matching an explicit alternative
cases.input_contract: Return fact_id, dimension_row from an inner join using NULL-safe key equality. Compare with ordinary equality and explain why the extra pair is a policy change.
cases.expected: The ordinary seven pairs plus(5,105) produce eight pairs. No C or D match is invented.
cases.verification: Assert all eight ordered pairs and isolate the extra NULL-key pair.

cases.title: Gate enrichment on a reviewed unique dimension
cases.input_contract: Reject a dimension unless key is nonnull and unique, then left-enrich facts with label while retaining fact_id and amount_cents. The supplied reviewed dimension rows 103,104,106 are the explicit accepted fixture;do not invent an arbitrary duplicate winner.
cases.expected: The raw dimension fails. The reviewed subset yields six facts, total 210, and labels alpha 3, alpha 3, beta, NULL, NULL, NULL for IDs 1..6.
cases.verification: Catch raw-dimension rejection, assert every enriched row and reconcile count 6, total 210.
